policy: Read-only archive checks; no extraction, source build, executable launch, deletion or original-file modification. Empty or inaccessible repositories remain labelled without ZIPs. README/license records contain names only. The original 18-project report is preserved once.
securityLimit: CRC, paths, source-file presence and hashes are verified. This is not a malware audit or a claim that any source builds or works with current GTA Online.

projects.availabilityNote: No branch references or committed files are available.
projects.verification: Catalog records an empty repository; no ZIP is represented as downloadable.

projects.availabilityNote: GitHub returns HTTP 403: repository unavailable due to a DMCA takedown.
projects.verification: Catalog records an unavailable repository; no ZIP is represented as downloadable.

targetedRecheck: Rechecked only failed/incomplete rows after restoring a missing public mirror from its verified backup. All earlier passed CRC/hash records are preserved.
